title: Zesty Sweet Jamaican Grain Pilaf
description: A sweet and crumbly Jamaican dish featuring mixed grain and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a brunch mood, and is halal-friendly.

ingredients.name: Mixed grain
ingredients.notes: including brown rice, quinoa, and bulgur

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mixed grain and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the ferment-kimchi, diced scotch bonnet pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the grain is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the brown sugar and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
